component.name: Jellyfesh
component.summary: 上品で軽やかな音楽プレーヤー
优雅、轻巧的音乐播放器
優雅、輕巧的音樂播放器

description.p: Jellyfesh plays your music library with gapless playback, word-by-word lyrics with translations, and colours taken from each album's artwork.

ul.li: Albums, artists, songs, playlists and favourites
Synchronised lyrics, with a word sweep for word-timed lyrics
A queue you reorder by dragging, with Play Next and Play Last
Media keys and desktop media controls

description.p: Public Beta. Jellyfesh looks and works the same in every app, with Settings as a page and one player bar on every page. Choose the sound quality from the bar, keep a mini player above your other windows, search with a tab for each source, see your servers' likes and playlists beside your own, and download albums and playlists from your own server to play offline. Covers show on Home again, and source playlists play and shuffle.

Public Beta. AI Lyrics makes word-timed lyrics on this computer or online with your own key, Customize changes the look and the layout as you watch, and both come with Jellyfesh Pro, free during the beta. Every source opens on its own Discover page, Get Info shows the sound's real quality, the lyrics bar follows each word, and Desktop Lyrics floats above your other windows.

Public Beta. The Luminous design: the cover's colour fills the window, glass panels float over it, and Now Playing becomes a stage with large lyrics and every control in one dock. Songs from QQ Music open in QQ Music, and Spotify plays on your own devices with Jellyfesh as the remote control.

The same places, words and steps as every Jellyfesh app: Settings in shared sections, Add a Source on the Sources page, sort menus with Descending, Most Played on Home, and confirmations before removing a folder or uninstalling a source.
A straight progress line, a player bar for wide windows, smoother motion, and more Appearance settings: accent colours, transparency, and the size and alignment of lyrics.
The first graphical Jellyfesh app for Linux.
